title: French Kissed Gratin
description: A creamy French-inspired gratin dish with a hint of exotic kissed spice and the soothing aroma of monsoon herbs.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk until smooth, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking continuously, until sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in kissed spice, salt, and grated cheese.
In a separate pan, toast cubed French bread until golden brown.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of toasted bread.
Pour half of the cheese sauce over the bread, followed by half of the monsoon herbs.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of cheese sauce on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional monsoon herbs if desired.
